sources.name: JM delivered-cost calculator
sources.evidence: Pure function test suite added; protected endpoint POST /shopping/landed-cost added on feature branch.
sources.notes: Ranks verified delivered totals only when shipping, VAT/tax treatment, customs and coupon state are explicit. Unknown components remain null; never treat the lowest item price as the cheapest delivered offer.

sources.name: TelePeças API
sources.evidence: Official TelePeças developer portal and API docs fetched 2026-10-17.
sources.notes: Portal says APIs are free and supports sandbox/production; OAuth2 and seller/integrator permissions required. Marketing page claims stock, OEM compatibility, plate/VIN, quotes/orders and webhooks. Confirm current endpoint for plate lookup and actual account permissions before integration.

sources.name: CarAPI.app Portugal plate-to-VIN
sources.evidence: Official docs list PT as supported; official pricing page lists 10/100/500/1000 credit packages.
sources.notes: Claims year/make/model/VIN; $0.40 per lookup in 10 pack, $0.35 in 100 pack, $0.30 in 500 pack, $0.25 in 1000 pack. Test plate examples are documented for US/CA/UK, not Portugal. No free Portugal test confirmed.

sources.name: eBay Browse API
sources.evidence: Official eBay developer docs fetched 2026-10-17.
sources.notes: Search by keyword/GTIN/product/compatibility and check item-level compatibility. Application access token required; verify production eligibility, shipping to Portugal and any seller-side constraints.

sources.name: SerpApi Google Shopping API
sources.evidence: Official API docs and pricing search checked 2026-10-17.
sources.notes: Portugal localization and free-shipping filter supported; cached exact searches are free. Search results indicate 250 searches/month free and $25/month for 1,000 paid searches. Product listings still require independent shipping, tax, stock and checkout verification.

sources.name: Render Free service limitations
sources.evidence: Official Render Free docs fetched 2026-10-17.
sources.notes: 15-minute idle spin-down, roughly one-minute cold start, ephemeral filesystem, 750 free instance-hours per workspace/month; free Postgres expires after 30 days. Prototype/testing only; not always-on production.
